data.thought: The epilogue failed because required objects are missing; we need to revise it to conditionally handle available objects and save whatever is produced.

args.instructions: Update the R epilogue to first check for the existence of each required object (sc, Xs, pd, decision, cf, fit) after the main script runs. For each object that exists, export it appropriately (e.g., sc -> frame.csv, pd/decision -> scores.csv, cf -> coefficients.csv, fit -> model.rds). If an object is missing, skip its export without error. Additionally, capture any other relevant objects (e.g., model, predictions) that may be present and include them in a single standard bundle file named 'export_bundle.rds' using saveRDS. Ensure the epilogue ends with a successful exit status.
